stem: The function \( w(t) = 270(1.029)^t \) can be used to estimate the number of whales in the North Atlantic Ocean at the end of \( t \) years. What does 1.029 represent in this function?

options.label: A
options.text: The initial number of whales in the North Atlantic Ocean

options.label: B
options.text: The decay factor of the number of whales in the North Atlantic Ocean

options.label: C
options.text: The number of whales in the North Atlantic Ocean at the end of the first year

options.label: D
options.text: The growth factor of the number of whales in the North Atlantic Ocean
